mapper.insert: INSERT INTO domainforge_outbox (event_id, topic, event_type, event_version, event_key, order_key, payload) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{event.topic}, #{event.type}, #{event.version}, #{event.key}, #{event.orderKey}, #{event.payload})
mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.event_id AS eventId, o.topic, o.event_type AS eventType, o.event_version AS version, o.event_key AS eventKey, o.order_key AS orderKey, o.payload, o.attempts FROM domainforge_outbox o WHERE o.sent_at IS NULL AND o.next_attempt_at <= now() AND (o.order_key IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM domainforge_outbox p WHERE p.order_key = o.order_key AND p.sent_at IS NULL AND p.id < o.id)) ORDER BY o.id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE domainforge_outbox SET sent_at = now(), last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM domainforge_outbox WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM domainforge_outbox WHERE sent_at IS NOT NULL AND sent_at < now() - make_interval(hours => #{retentionHours}) LIMIT #{limit})
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM domainforge_outbox WHERE sent_at IS NULL
